nodes.name: Daily 00:00 Warsaw
nodes.notes: ADR-065 Phase-3 autonomous producer. Fires daily at 01:00 Europe/Warsaw (workflow timezone is set to Europe/Warsaw in settings; 01:00 rather than 00:00 to avoid midnight-boundary brittleness). Scans ClickUp for tasks due TODAY (Warsaw) with exactly one assignee + [AI] Czy zadanie dla AI=Tak, not already actioned today, not closed/done, and enqueues one autonomous run per task. The schedule can't be fired via API — use the Form Trigger harness to test.

nodes.name: Run now (manual)
nodes.notes: Manual harness to run the producer on demand (the Schedule Trigger can't be fired via API). Same downstream path. Requires the workflow active to serve the form URL.

parameters.formDescription: Press submit to scan ClickUp for today's AI due-date tasks and enqueue autonomous runs.

nodes.name: Compute Window
nodes.notes: todayStr = today's date in Europe/Warsaw (en-CA YYYY-MM-DD), the authoritative day key. dueGt/dueLt = a WIDE (+-48h) unix-ms window for the ClickUp server-side prefilter; the real due-today gate is the in-memory Warsaw-date equality in Gate Tasks, so ClickUp's date-only storage-time convention can't cause a miss.

nodes.name: Read Queue Flag
nodes.notes: ADR-056: read config.queue.enabled ONCE (global, not per task) to choose enqueue vs synchronous fallback. onError:continueRegularOutput + retry -> a DB blip passes the Compute Window item through with no `value`, so Queue Enabled? evaluates false and every task falls back to the synchronous Run Agent Spine (fail-safe to the known-good path).

parameters.query: select value from config where key = 'queue.enabled' limit 1;

nodes.name: Fetch Due Tasks
nodes.notes: ClickUp Get Filtered Team Tasks (team 761759). Wide due window (Compute Window dueGt/dueLt), include_closed=false, subtasks=true (process tasks are usually subtasks). Single page (page=0): the 5-person team has far fewer than 100 tasks/day; if last_page comes back false, Build Summary Message escalates to WARN (truncation). NO onError: a total fetch failure must be LOUD -> global Error Handler CRITICAL, not a silent empty batch.

nodes.name: Gate Tasks
nodes.notes: Per-task gate (ADR-065): keep iff due-today in Europe/Warsaw AND exactly one assignee AND [AI] Czy zadanie dla AI=Tak AND status not closed/done. Drops the Alerts telemetry task defensively. Resolves impact ([AI] Wpływ) to one of 4 tiers (default Średni). Dropdown values may be the option id OR the orderindex int -> optName matches both. Emits ONE item {candidates, counts, last_page} so the summary path always has data even with 0 candidates.

nodes.name: Dedup Query
nodes.notes: ADR-065 operator rule: drop any task the agent ALREADY acted on today (Europe/Warsaw), ANY trigger. Returns the distinct task ids with an agent_runs row since Warsaw midnight. onError:continueRegularOutput + alwaysOutputData -> a DB blip passes through (no clickup_task_id rows), so Finalize treats it as no-dedup (fail-open: a missed dedup = at worst one extra run, also caught by the consumer's 24h bucket). param $1 = the candidate id array.

parameters.query: select distinct clickup_task_id from agent_runs where clickup_task_id = any($1::text[]) and created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'Europe/Warsaw') at time zone 'Europe/Warsaw');

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.notes: Subtract the already-actioned-today ids (Dedup Query rows) from the candidates. Emits one item per surviving task (_kind:task) PLUS exactly one summary item (_kind:summary) so the summary+heartbeat path ALWAYS runs (even with 0 survivors).

nodes.name: Route Kind
nodes.notes: Splits the Finalize output: _kind=task (output 0) -> dispatch; _kind=summary (output 1) -> heartbeat + batch summary.

nodes.name: Queue Enabled?
nodes.notes: ADR-056: queue.enabled=true -> enqueue (output 0); else (or unreadable) -> synchronous Run Agent Spine (output 1). Reads the global flag from Read Queue Flag.

nodes.name: Build Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: ADR-065 enqueue job (ADR-056 contract). invocation_type=due_date (consumer -> priority 5-8, triggered_by=due_date_daily, spine invocation_type=autonomous). caller_user_id=the single assignee (ADR-054 scope + ADR-064 spend gate). Empty triggering_comment_id -> Post Reply posts a NEW top-level comment. Keeps the task fields at top level alongside `job` so the enqueue-failed error branch reaches Run Agent Spine with the same shape as the queue-off branch.

nodes.name: Enqueue Job
nodes.notes: POST the job to the queue-consumer over the internal Docker network. onError:continueErrorOutput -> a non-200 / unreachable consumer routes to output 1, which fans out to Alert Enqueue Failed (WARN) AND Run Agent Spine (synchronous fallback) so a queued task is never silently dropped. Success (output 0) dead-ends.

nodes.name: Run Agent Spine
nodes.notes: Synchronous fallback (queue disabled OR enqueue failed). Calls the Agent Orchestrator inline. Reads task fields from the item ($json.taskId/assigneeId/assigneeUsername) — present on BOTH the queue-off task item and the enqueue-failed Build Enqueue Job item. triggered_by=due_date_daily, invocation_type=autonomous, empty comment id/text (top-level comment).

nodes.name: Alert Enqueue Failed
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) when /enqueue fails; the run still proceeds via the synchronous Run Agent Spine fallback.

value.message: Nie udało się dodać zadania due-date do kolejki — fallback do synchronicznego uruchomienia spine.

nodes.name: Stamp Heartbeat
nodes.notes: Liveness heartbeat for the dead-man's-switch (Due-Date Producer Freshness Monitor): upsert config.due_date_producer.last_run_at = now(). Runs on the summary path so it stamps EVERY producer execution, including zero-task nights. onError:continueRegularOutput so a DB blip never blocks the summary (a missed stamp self-heals next run; the monitor's 26h grace absorbs it).

parameters.query: insert into config (key, value) values ('due_date_producer.last_run_at', now()::text) on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value;

nodes.name: Build Summary Message
nodes.notes: Compose the Polish batch summary (counts) for Post Alert. Severity INFO normally; WARN if ClickUp paginated (last_page=false -> possible missed tasks).

nodes.name: Post Batch Summary
nodes.notes: Batch summary via the centralized Post Alert (v1) seam (INFO/WARN). No dedicated GM Reports task exists; reuse the established alert seam (unification rule). Also doubles as the human-visible liveness signal.
